events.verdict: Carter Jr. (CHI) cleanly deflects the ball away from Aldridge (SAS).
Bertans (SAS) places his hand momentarily on Parker's (CHI) side before immediately correcting.
[Observable in enhanced video] LaVine (CHI) moves his pivot foot after his gather.
Carter Jr. (CHI) engages with Aldridge (SAS) in the post but doesn't affect his ability to get to the pass.
Parker (SAS) legally contests DeRozan's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Mills (SAS) legally contests Arcidiacono's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Forbes (SAS) is already in Carter Jr.'s (CHI) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
Carter Jr. (CHI) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with Aldridge (SAS) in the post.
LaVine (CHI) legally contests Forbes' (SAS) jump shot attempt.
DeRozan (SAS) legally contests LaVine's (CHI) jump shot attempt.
Arcidiacono (CHI) commits a take foul on Aldridge (SAS).
Forbes (SAS) does not inbound the ball within five seconds.
RAR and MOB show Arcidiacono (CHI) cleanly steals the ball from Aldridge (SAS).
RAR shows Forbes (SAS) makes contact to Arcidiacono's (CHI) arm that causes him to lose control of the ball.
Arcidiacono (CHI) extends his leg as part of his natural shooting motion, any contact from Forbes (SAS) is considered incidental.
